# KPI Catalog

<!-- GENERATED by governance/kpi_dictionary/generate_catalog.py from kpis.yaml — do not hand-edit -->

Domains are strictly separate: no KPI blends Olist and UCI data, and BRL and GBP are never summed.
Olist GMV = SUM(item_price), freight excluded. UCI Gross Sales = invoiced value. **Neither is recognized revenue.** Targets/benchmarks: to be set by owner.

### Order-level KPIs under Product or Seller filters

Applies to: KPI_ORDERS, KPI_OTD_RATE, KPI_DELIVERY_DAYS, KPI_REVIEW_SCORE, KPI_APPROVAL_HOURS.

Under a product, category or seller filter, order-level KPIs (Orders, OTD %, Avg Delivery Days, Avg Review Score, Avg Approval Hours) count orders containing a matching line. Multi-category or multi-seller orders count once per category or seller, so totals across categories/sellers are not additive and none are shown implying additivity. Review score by category is 'Avg Review Score of orders containing category', not a product rating.

### Definitions and validation rules (olist)

- **KPI_GMV** — Sum of item price over all order lines of orders in scope (all statuses). EXCLUDES freight. GMV is NOT recognized revenue (no invoicing/revenue-recognition, refunds, tax or returns ledger in Olist). Rules: GMV must never be named or labelled 'Revenue' in any model, measure or visual; GMV >= KPI_NET_GMV for every period; sum(fct_order_items.item_price) == sum(stg_olist__order_items.item_price) (tolerance 0); freight excluded; see KPI_GMV_INCL_FREIGHT; fct_orders item rollup == fct_order_items (assert_recon_fct_orders_items_rollup)
- **KPI_GMV_INCL_FREIGHT** — Item price + customer-charged freight. Not revenue. Rules: == KPI_GMV + KPI_FREIGHT (tolerance 0.00)
- **KPI_NET_GMV** — GMV of orders whose status is not canceled/unavailable. Operational proxy; NOT net revenue (no returns/refund data). Rules: <= KPI_GMV; label must say 'Net GMV' not 'Net Revenue'
- **KPI_FREIGHT** — Freight charged to customers on order lines (customer-paid; NOT carrier/logistics cost). Rules: freight_value >= 0
- **KPI_FREIGHT_SHARE** — Freight as a share of item GMV. Rules: ratio of sums; never average of line ratios
- **KPI_PAYMENT_VALUE** — Sum of recorded payment values (all payment types incl. vouchers). Transaction value ≠ cash flow ≠ revenue. Rules: fct_payments never joined to fct_order_items (fan-out); Per order: |sum(payment_value) − sum(item_price+freight_value)| > 0.01 BRL, computed in exact numeric(12,2) (never float), is WARN not fail (dbt assert_payments_vs_items_freight). Known exceptions on 2026-10-30 build: 1,076 orders = 772 payment_without_items, 264 overpaid (installment interest?), 39 underpaid (voucher/discount?), 1 items_without_payment. Counts logged to dq_results with kpi_id KPI_PAYMENT_VALUE.
- **KPI_ORDERS** — Distinct orders placed (all statuses). Rules: order_id unique in fct_orders; count == distinct order_id in stg_olist__orders (tolerance 0)
- **KPI_AOV** — Item GMV per order that has at least one item. Rules: ratio of sums; never average of AOVs; denominator excludes orders with no items (e.g. some canceled/unavailable)
- **KPI_ITEMS_PER_ORDER** — Average order lines (=units; one row per unit in Olist) per order with items. Rules: >= 1
- **KPI_CANCEL_RATE** — Share of orders with status canceled or unavailable. Rules: 0..1; order_status accepted_values test passes
- **KPI_ACTIVE_CUSTOMERS** — Distinct real customers (customer_unique_id) with ≥1 order in period. Rules: must use customer_unique_id, NOT customer_id (customer_id is per order)
- **KPI_NEW_CUSTOMERS** — Customers whose first-ever order falls in the period. Rules: new + returning = active
- **KPI_REPEAT_RATE** — Share of customers (customer_unique_id) with ≥2 distinct orders within the selected period; customers with exactly one in-period order count in the denominator even if they ordered outside the period. Visuals must label it 'within selected period' (lifetime repeat rate = full coverage selected). Rules: report numerator & denominator with rate (low base expected; report as observed)
- **KPI_OTD_RATE** — Share of OTD-eligible orders (fct_deliveries.is_otd_eligible = status delivered AND delivered_customer_at not null AND delivered_customer_at >= purchased_at) whose delivered_customer_at date <= estimated_delivery_at date. Default date role is purchase date; [On-Time Delivery % (by Delivery Date)] is the same KPI on the delivery-date role. Rules: exclude delivered orders missing delivered_customer_at (counted as DQ); estimate is Olist's estimate, not a contractual SLA
- **KPI_DELIVERY_DAYS** — Mean days from purchase to customer delivery. Rules: delivered_customer_at >= purchased_at else flagged & excluded; timestamps local, no TZ (ASSUMPTION)
- **KPI_APPROVAL_HOURS** — Mean hours purchase → payment approval. Rules: approved_at >= purchased_at
- **KPI_REVIEW_SCORE** — Mean review score (1–5) using latest review per order. Proxy for satisfaction; not surveyed CSAT. Rules: score in 1..5; one review per order in KPI basis
- **KPI_LOW_REVIEW_RATE** — Share of reviewed orders scoring 1–2 (proxy for complaints). Rules: 0..1
- **KPI_GMV_GROWTH** — Month-over-month change in KPI_GMV. GMV growth, not revenue growth. Only computed when BOTH the month and prior month have dim_date.is_complete_month = true; otherwise BLANK. Rules: BLANK unless is_complete_month for current and prior month (int_olist__month_coverage → dim_date); is_low_volume_month months shown with caution flag; is_reporting_month governs default report range; assert_month_coverage_consistent passes
- **KPI_CUSTOMER_RETENTION** — Share of customers (customer_unique_id) active in the previous calendar month who order again in the current month. PARTIAL: very low repeat base makes it statistically unstable; show alongside [Retention Cohort Size]. Rules: show cohort size
- **KPI_DQ_SCORE** — Strict severity-weighted DQ score for a dbt run: only status 'pass' earns weight; 'warn' counts as not-pass (earns 0); skipped counts as fail. Weights: block=3, warn=1 (dq_check_config default). Default view = latest run (is_latest_run). Rules: core.dq_run_summary.dq_score == Σ(pass×weight)/Σ(weight) over core.dq_results for the same run_id (verified 2026-10-30 latest run: 505/506 = 0.9980); warn earns 0; skipped → fail; default filter is_latest_run = true; weights block=3, warn=1 unless overridden in dq_check_config
- **KPI_RECON_VARIANCE** — Difference of key KPIs between staging/source and marts/BI. Rules: counts tolerance 0; amounts 0.01 BRL
- **KPI_SELLER_HANDOVER_OTD** — Share of order items handed to the carrier (fct_deliveries.delivered_carrier_at) at or before the item's fct_order_items.shipping_limit_at, counting only items with both timestamps. PARTIAL: Olist records the carrier handover once per order, so every seller in a multi-seller order is measured against the same handover time. Rules: exclude items missing either timestamp (count separately as DQ); flag multi-seller orders; seller-level values for them share one order-level handover time; shipping_limit_at is Olist's seller deadline, not a contractual SLA; timestamp comparison, not date-only

### Not supported (olist)

| KPIs | Reason | Handling |
|---|---|---|
| Net/recognized revenue, Gross Profit, Gross Margin, Operating Profit/Margin, P&L, Cost per Order | No COGS, opex, invoicing, tax or GL in Olist | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| Target Achievement, Budget vs Actual, Budget Variance | No real targets/budgets; fabrication prohibited | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| CAC, ROAS, CTR, Marketing ROI | No marketing spend/impressions in Olist (Marketing Funnel has leads/deals only, separate dataset) | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| Return Rate / Refunds | No returns or refunds table | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| Inventory Turnover, Stockout, Fill Rate, Ageing | No inventory or stock data | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| Supplier/procurement KPIs (PPV, lead time, POs) | Sellers are marketplace merchants, not suppliers; no POs | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| Headcount, Attrition, Absenteeism, Hiring, Payroll | No HR data in Olist | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| Cash flow, AR/AP, Collections | Payments are transaction values, not cash settlement | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| Complaint Resolution Time | No complaint/ticket data; reviews are not tickets | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |
| Margin-based CLV | No cost data; revenue-based CLV would need explicit 'GMV-based' label | excluded; shown as 'not available from source'; never synthesized |

### Definitions and validation rules (uci)

- **KPI_UCI_GROSS_SALES** — Σ line_value of product lines on non-cancellation invoices (all have qty>0, price>0). Invoiced value, NOT recognized revenue. Product line = uci_fct_invoice_lines.line_type='product' (seed uci_stockcode_class on upper(StockCode): POST, DOT, C2 postage; M manual; D discount; S sample; BANK CHARGES, AMAZONFEE, CRUK fees; ADJUST% adjustment (prefix, incl. ADJUST2); TEST% test; GIFT_% voucher; B / 'A' invoices bad_debt; non-C qty<0 price 0 stock_writeoff; other price<=0 zero_price). Cancellation = Invoice starting 'C' (signed negative lines). GBP; exact numeric (unit_price numeric(12,3)). Rules: mart == fact == raw recompute, exact: 19,643,861.637 GBP on 2026-10-30 build (reconciliation fact, not a target); assert_uci_recon_mart_sales_daily_vs_fact; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_PRODUCT_CANCELLATIONS** — Signed (negative) value of product lines on C invoices. Cancellations, not confirmed returns. Rules: ≤ 0; −716,462.570 GBP on 2026-10-30 build; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_CANCEL_RATE_VALUE** — |Product cancellations| / gross product sales. Period rate (no link C→original invoice); can exceed 100% at fine grain. Rules: ratio of sums, not average of daily rates; product × month: uci_mart_product_monthly.cancellation_value_rate; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_CANCEL_RATE_LINES** — Product lines on C invoices / all product lines. Rules: no mart column: computed from uci_fct_invoice_lines (is_product_line, is_cancellation); assert_uci_cancellation_linkage: 1 known C line with qty ≥ 0 (warn); GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_CANCEL_RATE_INVOICES** — Cancellation invoices / (sales invoices + cancellation invoices). Rules: ratio of sums; daily column cancellation_invoice_rate must not be averaged; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_DISCOUNTS** — Signed value of discount lines (StockCode D). Rules: −12,879.630 GBP on 2026-10-30 build; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_NET_SALES_PROXY** — Gross product sales + product cancellations + discounts (signed). Decision D3 approved: postage and fees excluded and reported separately (KPI_UCI_POSTAGE_FEES). Operational proxy, NOT recognized revenue (no tax, cost or returns ledger). Rules: label exactly 'Net Sales (proxy)'; == gross + cancellations + discounts exactly; 18,914,519.437 GBP on 2026-10-30 build; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_INVOICES** — Distinct non-cancellation invoices (all line types). Rules: 45,336 on 2026-10-30 build; 39,516 contain ≥1 product line (sales_invoices_with_products); GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_AOV** — Net Sales (proxy) / sales invoices. uci_mart_sales_daily.aov_gbp implements this definition (aligned with Data Engineering on 2026-10-30; overall value at that build was GBP 417.21). The former gross-product ratio is gross_product_value_per_product_invoice_gbp and is not KPI_UCI_AOV. Rules: ratio of sums; do not average aov_gbp across days; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'; at any grain above invoice, recompute from SUM(net_sales_proxy_gbp)/SUM(sales_invoice_count); never average aov_gbp; gross_product_value_per_product_invoice_gbp is not AOV
- **KPI_UCI_UNITS_PER_INVOICE** — Product units sold per sales invoice with products. Rules: ratio of sums; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_POSTAGE_FEES** — Postage lines (POST, DOT, C2) and fee lines (BANK CHARGES, AMAZONFEE, CRUK), shown as two components; excluded from Net Sales (proxy). Rules: postage 433,410.510; fees −264,936.179 GBP on 2026-10-30 build; other_non_product reported separately too; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_ACTIVE_CUSTOMERS** — Distinct identified customers with ≥1 sales invoice in period. Identified customers only: 22.8% of deduped lines have no Customer ID (unknown member -1, excluded); show the share alongside. Rules: never sum daily active_customers across days; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_NEW_CUSTOMERS** — Identified customers whose first purchase falls in the period. 2009-12 overstated (no prior history). Identified customers only: 22.8% of deduped lines have no Customer ID (unknown member -1, excluded); show the share alongside. Rules: 2009-12 flagged: dataset start, not true acquisition; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_REPEAT_RATE** — Share of identified customers with ≥2 sales invoices over full coverage. Identified customers only: 22.8% of deduped lines have no Customer ID (unknown member -1, excluded); show the share alongside. Rules: window = full coverage 2009-12-01 → 2011-12-09; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_RETENTION** — Share of a monthly first-purchase cohort active in month n. PARTIAL: 2009-12 cohort mixes pre-existing customers; 2011-12 partial (to 2011-12-09) via int_uci__month_coverage; 22.8% of lines without Customer ID excluded. Rules: months_since_first_purchase=0 → 100%; partial months blank in trend; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_RFM_SEGMENT** — Descriptive segmentation, NOT a prediction. Snapshot = max(invoice_ts)::date + 1 (2011-12-10). R = recency_days, F = sales invoices, M = Σ net_sales_proxy_gbp; each NTILE(5) (R reversed: recent=5). PARTIAL: identified customers only; segment-label rules to be documented by owner. Rules: one row per customer (assert_uci_grain_mart_customer_rfm); M uses Net Sales (proxy), may be ≤ 0 for net-cancelling customers; GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_PRODUCT_CONTRIBUTION** — Product share of gross product sales. Rules: Σ gross_sales == KPI_UCI_GROSS_SALES exactly (assert_uci_recon_mart_product_vs_fact); GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'
- **KPI_UCI_COUNTRY_CONTRIBUTION** — Invoice-country share of gross product sales. UK ≈ 85.5% — show a non-UK view. 'Unspecified' kept as own member. Rules: Σ == KPI_UCI_GROSS_SALES exactly (19,643,861.637 verified 2026-10-30); GBP only; never combined with Olist (BRL); no join to core.*; never labelled 'Revenue'

### Not supported (uci)

| KPIs | Reason | Handling |
|---|---|---|
| UCI Gross Profit / Margin | No product cost/COGS in Online Retail II | excluded; never synthesized |
| UCI True Return Rate | Cancellation (C) invoices have no link to the original invoice and are not confirmed returns | excluded; only cancellation rates published |
| UCI CAC / ROAS | No marketing spend data | excluded; never synthesized |
